rows.notes: The paper is a conceptual system proposal (block, component, use-case and flow diagrams for an IoT/ML/AR drone farming system). It reports no data, measurements, experiments, surveys or model runs; the 'Results' section is narrative and only mentions unspecified 'encouraging feedback from testing phases' without any reported outcome. Even taken as a primary study, it contains no result on remote sensing or UAV spraying for pest suppression: the proposed drone is described for fertilizer spreading via AR mapping, and pest/disease detection is mentioned only as an aspirational capability, not tested or measured. No evidence on NUE or pest suppression efficacy.

notes: Full text appears complete (7 pages, ACM ICIMMI 2023). The document is a design/concept paper with a literature survey and system description; no empirical results are reported, so it cannot substantiate the claim about UAV prescription spraying improving pest suppression efficacy.
